items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was in a little band – I was talking about the tobacco barn – with Ellsworth Gibson.

ctx.x: When you were there, what were your peers . . . ?
Oh. That’s what I was trying to think about. I was in a little band – I was talking about the tobacco barn – with Ellsworth Gibson. You know Ellsworth. Gib.
